title: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive…
description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data version 5.4.0.0 contains an XML External Entity (XXE) injection vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to access sensitive information. The vulnerability requires authentication and does not allow code execution or denial of service. It has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.0.
